nodes.title: How to Use
widgets_values:
This example workflow demonstrates Batch Images node.

1. Set folder_path to your image folder (default is ComfyUI/input)
2. Adjust image_extensions if needed (supports png,jpg,jpeg,webp,bmp,gif)
3. Choose sorting: 'name', 'modified', or 'created'
4. Use start_index to skip first N images
5. Use max_images to limit batch (0 = all images)

The node will load all matching images and output them as a batch.
ComfyUI will automatically process each image through your workflow!

nodes.title: Next Steps
widgets_values:
To complete this workflow, replace PreviewImage with your processing:

• VAE Encode (if using img2img)
• Your processing nodes (upscale, denoise, etc.)
• VAE Decode (if you encoded)
• Save Image (to save processed images)

The batch will process automatically!
